visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vertical history timeline with year markers and image cards
visualCharacteristics.layout: Dotted vertical line with a ring marker per entry; year left of the line, card (image, caption) right; line centred from 960px
notable: shadow option is not a timeline: text column beside raised contact cards

contentPattern.structure: One row per entry: year cell and content cell (picture, caption heading / paragraph, text); shadow: cells become a text column and contact cards

usage: Use for history pages listing milestones by year.
reuseGuidance: Fits dated entries with one image each; milestones and carousel-text-media cover sliding history views. The shadow option is a catalog placement for text + contact cards and may move to columns or cards (contact) later.
